captions.detailed: A low-profile, ring-shaped speaker mounting bracket with four evenly spaced mounting tabs protruding outwards at 90-degree intervals. The inner rim features a stepped circular flange designed to support a speaker basket, creating a dual-diameter opening with a larger top recess and a smaller through-hole. Each of the four rounded tabs has a small, vertical screw hole running through its center for secure surface mounting.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric speaker mounting ring in OpenSCAD with four integrated screw tabs spaced 90 degrees apart. The model should feature adjustable parameters for the overall height, speaker diameter, stepped flange depth and width, mounting tab length, and screw hole radius.
captions.factory: The script defines a 2D profile module 'drawclip' using a circle for the main ring, combined with hull-based rounded tabs modeled as circles and subtracted screw holes, rotated at 0 and 90 degrees. A 3D module 'drawinside' creates the stepped inner recess by subtracting two concentric cylinders (representing the flange and speaker opening) from a large bounding cube. Finally, the 2D clip profile is linear_extruded to the specified height, intersected with the 3D inside module, and rotated 180 degrees to orient it for support-free 3D printing.
